expo.label: (EXPO ZONE)
expo.title: WHERE INDUSTRIES EXHIBIT
expo.text: ICCB Expo Village is Bangladesh's largest dedicated exhibition space, hosting international trade fairs, product launches, and industry showcases attended by global organisations.
expo.photoAlt: ICCB Expo Village — international trade fair

partners.text: We are proud to host leading international organisations and exhibitors across diverse sectors, bringing the world to Bangladesh.

menu.title: Menus Crafted
menu.description: From Mughal feasts to delicate desserts — every plate is prepared fresh in our own kitchen.
menu.custom: Custom menus available for all event sizes — 50 to 10,000 guests.

mughal.label: Mughal Classic
mughal.desc: Rich gravies, slow-cooked meats, aromatic biryanis.

continental.label: Continental
continental.desc: Refined European dishes with fresh seasonal produce.

breakfast.label: Breakfast Setup
breakfast.desc: Fresh-brewed coffee, pastries, and hot buffet.

events.label: (EVENTS WE HOST)
events.title: ONE VENUE,
events.text: Weddings, receptions, corporate programs, conferences, seminars and concerts — every kind of celebration and gathering finds its perfect stage at ICCB.

wedding.label: Wedding
wedding.title: Weddings Dressed in Grandeur
wedding.desc: From the stage to the last table, we craft wedding nights for up to thousands of guests — décor, lighting, catering and a dedicated coordinator under one roof.

holud.label: Holud
holud.title: Colours of Holud & Mehendi
holud.desc: Marigold, music and turmeric-yellow joy — intimate halls and themed décor that bring every pre-wedding tradition to life.

reception.label: Reception
reception.title: Receptions to Remember
reception.desc: Elegant banquet set-ups, signature menus from our double kitchen and seamless service for receptions of every size.

corporate.label: Corporate
corporate.title: Corporate Programs That Impress
corporate.desc: Annual general meetings, dealer conferences, award nights and product launches — with stage, sound, LED walls and hospitality handled for you.

conference.label: Conference
conference.title: Conferences on a National Scale
conference.desc: Pillar-free halls, interpretation booths and video conferencing make ICCB the home of summits and international conventions.

seminar.label: Seminar
seminar.title: Seminars Built for Focus
seminar.desc: Theatre or classroom layouts, projectors and crystal-clear audio — ready for trainings, workshops and academic programmes.

concert.label: Concert
concert.title: Concerts & Cultural Nights
concert.desc: Professional rigging, 10,000W sound and room for thousands — the stage is set for music, shows and cultural celebrations.

expo.label: Expo
expo.title: Exhibitions & Trade Fairs
expo.desc: Expo Village — the country's largest single-roof exhibition space — hosts national fairs, product showcases and international expos.

why.label: (FACILITIES)
why.title: WHY CHOOSE
why.text: Every detail is designed to make your event flawless. World-class infrastructure, professional staff, and comprehensive services — all in one iconic location.

parking.title: 2,000+ Parking Spaces
parking.desc: Dedicated on-site parking for large events, with security and valet service.

power.title: Full Power Backup
power.desc: High-capacity generators ensure uninterrupted power throughout all events.

ac.title: Central Air Conditioning
ac.desc: Precision-controlled climate in all halls, keeping every event comfortable.

kitchen.title: Own Modern Kitchen
kitchen.desc: State-of-the-art kitchen with strict quality-control from farm to table.

security.title: 24/7 Security
security.desc: Professional security team, CCTV coverage, and controlled access throughout.

access.title: Fully Accessible
access.desc: Wheelchair access, lifts, and accessible facilities across all venues.

location.title: Prime Location
location.desc: On the 300 ft. Purbachal Express Highway, 25 km from Dhaka airport.

internet.title: High-Speed Internet
internet.desc: Dedicated fiber-optic connectivity for conferences and hybrid events.

gallery.title: Moments at
gallery.description: From international expos and high-level summits to grand weddings and live concerts — step inside the halls where Bangladesh gathers, celebrates and does business.

cta.title: Planning an event?
cta.text: Get in touch with our team for venue availability, catering menus or a customised event package.
